title: SAP layoffs: German company may cut 10,000 jobs across engineering, sales and product teams
description: SAP is considering eliminating at least 10,000 positions as it reshapes its business around artificial intelligence, potentially affecting more than 9 per cent of its global workforce. The proposed restructuring could target product development, engineering and sales teams, as the German software maker looks to improve productivity and streamline operations.

title: JP Morgan: 24 million jobs at risk globally over the next five years due to AI
description: Artificial intelligence could displace around 24 million knowledge-worker jobs worldwide over the next five years under an illustrative scenario, according to a JP Morgan Wealth Management report. The US could account for nearly 16 million affected workers. However, the report said AI is more likely to change tasks within existing jobs than eliminate entire roles, with adoption expected to remain gradual and uneven.
